description: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) reports for a specific drug. Each result describes a reported adverse reaction including patient demographics, reactions, outcome, and seriousness. Used for pharmacovigilance and post-market safety analysis.

drug.description: Drug name (brand or generic) to query FAERS for. Example: 'Lipitor' or 'atorvastatin'.

serious_only.description: If true, only return serious adverse events (death, hospitalization, life-threatening, disability).

name: fda_drug_adverse_events
